oracle.method: Independently constructed CPU spatial octree with child-order DFS and warp32 collective opening, higher precision COM/forces/integration and FP32-rounded public positions. Genuine tree approximation, not dense all-pairs surrogate.
oracle.scope_limit: Same predeclared 5case finite-time operator/pipeline tolerance; not fullapplication, allCLI regimes or long-time accuracy/stability proof.

cuda.evidence_scope: Complete final-tree DFS/count/start/sort/mass/finiteCOM selfchecks executed after every measured case; allocator-dependent node IDs are not public cross-model outputs. Exact guard bytes checked outside ROI, summarized in raw logs.
